description: Master Regression, Classification, and Interpretable Models

slides.title: Regression vs Classification
slides.content:
# Two Main Tasks 🎯

## Regression
Predicting a **continuous** number.
- *House Price*: $250k, $500k...
- *Temperature*: 25.5°C, 30°C...
- **Algorithms**: Linear Regression, Decision Tree Regressor.

## Classification
Predicting a **discrete** category (class).
- *Spam Filter*: Spam or Not Spam (Binary).
- *Image Recognition*: Cat, Dog, or Bird (Multi-class).
- **Algorithms**: Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM, Decision Trees.

slides.title: Ensemble Methods
slides.content:
# Ensemble Learning 🌳🌲🌳

Why use one model when you can use many? Ensemble methods combine multiple "weak" models to create a strong one.

## 1. Bagging (Bootstrap Aggregating)
Trains models independently on random subsets of data and averages predictions.
- **Example**: **Random Forest** (A forest of decision trees).

## 2. Boosting
Trains models sequentially. Each model fixes the errors of the previous one.
- **Examples**: Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, AdaBoost.

> 💡 **Tip**: In Kaggle competitions, XGBoost and Gradient Boosting are almost always the winners for tabular data!

slides.title: Evaluation Metrics
slides.content:
# How Good is the Model? 📊

Accuracy isn't everything!

## Classification Metrics
- **Accuracy**: % of correct predictions.
- **Precision**: Of all predicted positives, how many were real? (Avoid False Positives).
- **Recall**: Of all real positives, how many did we catch? (Avoid False Negatives).
- **F1-Score**: Harmonic mean of Precision and Recall.

## Regression Metrics
- **MAE (Mean Absolute Error)**: Average error magnitude.
- **MSE (Mean Squared Error)**: Punishes large errors heavily.
- **R² Score**: How well the model explains the variance (0 to 1).
